A '''''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle''' was used by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama's]] [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] was painted silver, with the red markings of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang|pirate gang]] on the sides.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

==History==
[[File:Alama_crashed.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alama's ''Flarestar'' crashed on the surface of Florrum]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shahan Alama, along with [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and the rest of Bane's posse went on a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis">''{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> The mission was a success, and after escaping, Bane ordered his posse to disperse and go into hiding. Alama took his ''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. There, he was confronted by a small [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] force led by a [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian]], and then a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] force under the command of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

==Behind the scenes==
It is probable that Alama did not actually own this ''Flarestar''-class ship, but rather, was borrowing it from Ohnaka. The ship bore the mark of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang, and it seemed apparent by the way that Alama was greeted by Ohnaka that he was not a member of the latter's pirate gang.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Bonus">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]] bonus page</ref>
